# Cross-artifact join: SARIF partialFingerprints <-> findings.json case_id <-> finding_case.json
# Ids the dup guard folded in: each twin is its own case, so the survivor publishes them to join
# SARIF result is additionalProperties:false, so a block outside properties fails validation
# A fingerprint-less row keeps the primary key, so loc/title fallback matching still resolves
# uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, "https://cwe.mitre.org/"); literal for cross-run joins, must stay RFC-4122
# TRAP: widening CWE_NAMES reshapes ruleIds and reopens alerts; norm_cwe saves the taxonomy sort
# channel and origin are legs: without them a CRITICAL folds into its posture or detector twin
# Severity ranks, not first-wins: a LOW twin would ship level:note/0.1 and pass an error gate
# Redact before the 4000-char cut, or cutting bisects a secret and ships its raw prefix
# cfg is optional at every call site, so these fallbacks must track config._STEP_DEFAULTS
# distinct emitted ruleIds, in first-seen order
# ruleId → first resolvable CWE name
# effective CWE per finding (taxonomy input)
# ruleId → first resolvable effective CWE, for the rule tag
# ruleId → highest result security-severity, for the rule
# Recomputed from the vector (-1.0 sentinel), so a stale DTO cvss_score cannot skew ranking
# Resolved BEFORE the loop or report order beats severity; aliases too, as a winner can be late
# Seeded with every PRIMARY up front, so order cannot matter; path_prefix applied producer-side
# Skip BEFORE rules/taxa mutation; the twin's id is published on the survivor's aliases
# String max would sort "9.0" above "10.0", so compare numerically.
# Markdown asterisks are deliberate: this matches the report line's tail verbatim
# No exploit-verification, confidence or votes keys: no stage produces a real value
# Verbatim path: no _md_cell folding of backticks or pipes.
# One key collapses own/sibling/earlier anchors; the role-annotated refs are exempt
# After description so it serializes last, before the refs join: dup sites only
# Carried verbatim from the s6-stamped DTO field; s9 does no routing.
# "detector" or "s6_discovered"; chunk_id is never emitted, so lineage is lost here
# SARIF result.rank is 0.0-100.0, so the 0-10 CVSS base score scales up
# One block: the checkpointed profile and CLI app_info can disagree and mislabel the report
# Health comes from the report, no sidecar, and is emitted on EVERY run for observability
# "non-fatal" is a wording contract with the MD Scan Health section
# Degradation means chain/narrative enrichment was unavailable, never missing ranking
# exit-0-but-empty though executionSuccessful=true; always emitted (absence=older doc)
# A THIRD question: coverage lost, not "degraded" or "hollow"; reason codes say which fired
# Ranked threats S3 minted no unit for were never reviewed, so no finding is not an all-clear.
# Always emitted: null = payload predates the field (as in findings.json), [] = full coverage
# threatsTotal is post-cap, so without these it reads as everything that was ever found
# The emitted count, not len(report.findings): the dup guard suppresses twins
